generationInputs.prompt: An 8-second hyper-realistic cinematic underwater video shot with a RED V-Raptor cinema camera and 24mm wide-angle anamorphic lens, showcasing a vast, dark cavern. A slow, circular tracking shot orbits a massive, glowing blue quartz crystal formation at the center. The crystal emits powerful, pulsating blue light, casting dramatic, soft-edged moving shadows and shimmering caustic light patterns on cavern walls. Two divers in slightly worn futuristic gear swim gracefully, holding transparent, holographic tablet-like devices. Photorealistic air bubbles rise from their equipment. Visible particulate matter drifts. The scene has a fine layer of cinematic film grain and a deep teal and orange color grade. The audio features immense water pressure, crisp bubble sounds, a bass-heavy hum from the crystal synchronized with its light, and an epic orchestral score with synthesizer and choir, building to a crescendo. 16:9 aspect ratio, 1080p.
